blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality.
For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.
blocks.zh:
预先训练的视觉表现支持图像生成,但可能不能完全保存忠实重建所需的精细细节. 同时,中间编码器层包含互补的视觉细节,但学习将其引信用于重建可以产生潜在的分布,难以模拟. 现有的聚变方法需要经验性地调整层选择,或分阶段优化聚变和解码,增加配置努力或训练的复杂性. 我们引入了HIRAE(Hirarchical Descriptional Autoencoder),它学习了一个超越全编码器结构的分级聚变框架,以提高重建忠心度,同时保持与基因模型的兼容性. HIRAE按深度分组编码器层,并学习对最深层代表的剩余校正. 与深度锚地相比,分组规范上限将这些更正捆绑起来,对较浅层组的预算更为严格。 我们的HIRAE -24 保存潜在的符号数和通道维度。 在ImageNet-256上,HIRAE-24相对RAEv2将重建FID从0.299减少到0.209,同时保持有竞争力的导电生成质量.
对于文本到图像生成,HIRAE-24在GenEval,DPG-Bench,以及GenAI-Bench上改进了在监督的微调前后的RAEv2对调. 根据同一发电机培训和评价规程,精细调试后的GENEval从84.86增加到87.70。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pretrained vision encoders provide semantically organized representations for image generation, but their final outputs can omit details needed for faithful reconstruction [ 22 , 20 ] . Representation Autoencoders (RAE) [ 27 ] pair these frozen encoders with learned decoders and train diffusion models in the resulting latent space. Many previous methods rely solely on the highly abstracted semantic features of the final encoder layer, whereas reconstruction depends more on the detailed features retained in intermediate layers [ 20 , 29 ] . Learning to use this information offers a route to higher reconstruction fidelity while retaining the pretrained encoder as the basis for generation.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视觉编码器为图像生成提供了有条不紊的表达方式,但其最终输出可以省略忠实重建所需的细节[22,20]. 代表自动编码器(RAE)[27]将这些冷冻编码器与在由此产生的潜在空间中学习的解码器和火车扩散模型配对。 许多之前的方法完全依赖于最终编码层高度抽象的语义特征,而重建则更多地依赖于中间层中保留的详细特征[20,29]. 学会使用这些信息为更高的重建忠诚度提供了一个途径,同时保留了预先训练的编码器作为生成的基础.

blocks.en:
Recent tokenizers exploit the visual hierarchy to recover details missing from final-layer representations, through fixed aggregation (RAEv2; 20 ), learned full-depth fusion (DRoRAE; 29 ), or queries over intermediate features (DecQ; 22 ). IDEAL [ 4 ] combines selected shallow and deep features before quantization, while LV-RAE [ 14 ] supplements semantic features with a separate encoder for low-level detail. DecQ shows that using shallower layers or increasing the number of detail queries can improve reconstruction while worsening generation. For learned fusion, this trade-off raises a further concern: reconstruction-driven training can favor shallow-layer detail without accounting for its effect on generation quality. Existing approaches reconcile reconstruction and generation through predefined layer aggregation, additional detail pathways, or staged adaptation of fusion and decoding. Our seven-layer experiments show that learned fusion improves reconstruction while supporting guided generation, but identifying a suitable layer subset requires repeated training and evaluation. We aim to learn a unified representation for reconstruction and generation through joint training of full-hierarchy fusion and the decoder.
How can we learn full-hierarchy fusion that improves reconstruction while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling?
blocks.zh:
近期的标致器利用视觉结构来通过固定聚合(RAEv2; 20 ),学习到的全深度聚变(DRORAE; 29 ),或对中间特征的查询(DecQ; 22 ),来恢复最终层表示中缺失的细节. EIDEL [4] 在量化前结合了选定的浅深特征,而LV-RAE [14] 补充语义特征,为低级细节另设编码器. DecQ显示,使用更浅的层或增加细节查询数量,可以改善重建,同时恶化生成. 对于有学识的融合,这种权衡又引起了另一个关切:重建驱动的培训可以倾向于浅层细节,而不考虑其对生成质量的影响。 现有方法通过预定义的层集合,额外的细节路径,或分阶段调整聚变和解码,调和重建与生成. 我们的七层实验显示,学习的聚变在支持引导生成的同时改善重建,但确定合适的层子集需要反复培训和评价. 我们的目标是通过对全等级聚变和解码器的联合培训,为重建和生成学习统一的代表。

blocks.en:
We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), a hierarchical fusion framework that integrates representations across encoder depths into a shared latent space for reconstruction and generation. Its main configuration, HiRAE-24, learns spatially varying contributions from all 24 layers of a frozen DINOv3-L encoder, avoiding manual layer-subset selection. Building on DRoRAE’s learned residual fusion [ 29 ] , HiRAE organizes encoder layers into shallow, middle, and deep groups. Each group learns a residual correction to the deepest representation, with a distinct norm budget that increases with depth. These designs allow us to constrain how fusion modifies the deepest representation and jointly train the fusion module and decoder without a separate fusion-only adaptation phase. The fused representation preserves the original latent token count and channel dimension.
On ImageNet-256 [ 5 ] , HiRAE-24 reduces rFID from 0.299 to 0.209, a 30% reduction relative to RAEv2 [ 20 ] . On the matched 5,000-image reconstruction subset, it increases PSNR from 22.667 to 26.377 dB and reduces LPIPS [ 26 ] from 0.074 to 0.043. After 80 epochs of generator training, guided generation FID decreases from 1.060 to 1.038 (Figure ). Analysis shows that fusion adds spatial detail while largely preserving class neighborhoods. The learned tokenizer also exhibits lower decoding sensitivity to the tested latent perturbations.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Hierarchical representation autoencoding. We introduce HiRAE, a hierarchical fusion framework with depth-dependent residual budgets. These budgets control intermediate-layer contributions to enrich the deepest representation with complementary visual detail. • Higher reconstruction fidelity and improved text-to-image alignment. blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Latent diffusion models such as LDM and DiT generate images in the compressed spaces of reconstruction-trained autoencoders [ 18 , 17 ] .
Representation alignment connects these generative models with pretrained visual encoders at different stages: REPA supervises diffusion features, whereas VA-VAE regularizes the tokenizer latents themselves [ 25 , 24 ] .
Extending this connection to joint optimization, REPA-E uses alignment to support end-to-end tuning of the VAE and diffusion model [ 12 ] .
RAE takes a more direct route by pairing a frozen vision encoder with a learned decoder and training diffusion in the encoder’s representation space [ 27 ] .
HiRAE extends RAE with a learnable fusion module over the full frozen encoder hierarchy and jointly trains this module with the decoder.
blocks.zh:
LDM和DIT等Lententnt扩散模型在重建训练自动编码器的压缩空间中生成图像[18,17].
表示调和使这些基因模型与不同阶段的预先训练的视觉编码器相连接:REPA监督扩散特征,而VA-VAE则使指示器潜伏本身规范化[25,24].
将这种连接扩展到联合优化,REPA-E使用对齐支持对VAE的端对端调和和传播模式[12].
RAE采取更直接的路线,将冷冻的视觉编码器与熟知的解码器配对,并在编码器的表示空间进行训练传播[27].
HIRAE将RAE用可学习的聚变模块延伸至全冷凝编码器的层次,并与解码器共同训练这个模块.

blocks.en:
RAEv2 [ 20 ] extends representation autoencoding through fixed aggregation of selected encoder layers, incorporating intermediate-layer detail into the representation used for reconstruction and generation.
The aggregation itself introduces no learned fusion module, making layer selection a key design choice.
Related detail-enrichment designs include shallow-deep fusion before quantization in IDEAL and additional detail representations in DecQ and LV-RAE [ 4 , 22 , 14 ] .
For learnable multi-layer fusion, DRoRAE combines layer-wise experts with routing across all encoder layers and trains the fusion module before adapting the decoder [ 29 ] .
Building on this learned full-depth fusion, HiRAE introduces depth-dependent residual budgets that support joint fusion and decoder training.
blocks.zh:
RAEv2[20]通过固定汇总选定的编码层来扩展表示式自动编码,将中间层细节纳入用于重建和生成的表示式中.
聚合本身没有引入学习的聚变模块,使层选择成为关键设计选择.
相关的细节浓缩设计包括EIDOL中量化前的浅深聚变,以及DecQ和LV-RAE中的额外细节表述 [4, 22, 14].
对于可学习的多层聚变,DRORAE在调适解码器[29]前,结合了分层专家与所有编码器层的路由,并训练聚变模块.
借助于这次深入的融合 HIRAE引入了依赖深度的剩余预算,支持联合聚变和解码器培训.

blocks.en:
Adding reconstruction detail also changes the representation that the generator must model, so improvements in reconstruction alone do not establish better generation [ 24 , 22 ] .
FAE and HAE adapt pretrained representations for generation through feature compression and hyperspherical modeling, respectively [ 7 , 2 ] .
Complementing these architectural approaches, Zhong et al. [28] systematically examine how latent properties relate to generation quality across tokenizer families.
Our analysis examines this relationship within hierarchical fusion: we measure changes in spatial detail and class neighborhoods, together with the decoding response to latent perturbations.
blocks.zh:
增加重建细节也会改变发电机必须建模的表示方式,因此仅靠重建的改善并不能建立更好的生成[24,22].
FAE和HAE分别通过特性压缩和超球形模型调整预修的表示生成功能[7,2].
Zhong等人[28]在补充这些建筑方法时,系统地审查了潜在的特性与象征性家庭的发电质量之间的关系。
我们的分析研究了分级结合中的这种关系:我们测量空间细节和阶级邻里的变化,以及对潜在扰动的解码反应。

blocks.zh: 图1:RAEv2、DRORAE和HIRAE-24的图层使用和装饰剂培训。

blocks.en: HiRAE-24 learns to use all encoder layers while jointly training the fusion module and decoder (Figure 1 ). A separate learned transformation (expert) processes each layer’s output, and a router learns the expert contributions at each spatial location. To prevent the latent space from drifting toward a reconstruction-dominated distribution during joint training, HiRAE combines these outputs into shallow, middle, and deep residual groups around the deepest-layer anchor. Group-wise norm caps assign tighter correction budgets to shallower groups, with residual dropout providing additional regularization. The encoder stays frozen, and the fused latent preserves its token count and channel dimension (Figure 2 ).

blocks.en: For reconstruction and class-conditional generation, we train and evaluate HiRAE on ImageNet-1K [ 5 ] . For image reconstruction, we train the tokenizer on the training split at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution and evaluate on the validation split. Following the ADM evaluation protocol [ 6 ] , we generate 50,000 images per configuration for FID computation. For text-to-image (T2I) generation, we follow RAEv2 [ 20 ] and pretrain on JourneyDB [ 21 ] together with the long-caption and short-caption subsets of BLIP3o [ 3 ] , using 256 × 256 256\times 256 images. We then apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on BLIP3o-60k.

blocks.en:
HiRAE improves reconstruction fidelity within the original latent dimensions. With the same frozen DINOv3-L encoder and 16 × 16 × 1024 16\times 16\times 1024 latent shape, HiRAE-24 reduces rFID from the RAEv2 result of 0.299 to 0.209, a reduction of approximately 30% (Table 1 ). On the matched 5,000-image subset, PSNR increases from 22.667 to 26.377 dB and LPIPS decreases from 0.074 to 0.043. The improvement therefore covers both pixel accuracy and perceptual similarity. Learned full-hierarchy fusion and joint decoder training recover finer image detail without increasing the generator’s latent token count or channel dimension.
As shown in Figure 3 , HiRAE-24 more faithfully preserves text strokes and local colors. RAEv2 retains the overall image content but exhibits distortions in fine structures and local color shifts. These comparisons complement the rFID improvement, showing that controlled hierarchical fusion can recover image-specific details while maintaining the scene structure.
The improvement also extends across all four quartiles of original-image texture strength. More textured images show larger LPIPS reductions and a larger effect from removing the shallow residual group (Appendix C.3 ), complementing the visual examples.
blocks.zh:
HIRAE在最初潜伏的维度内改善重建忠心. HIRAE-24使用同样冷冻的DINOv3-L编码器和16×16 × 1024 16\times 16\times 1024潜伏形状,将RAEv2结果的rFID减少0.299至0.209,减少约30%(表1). 在对应的5000图像子集上,PSNR从22.667增加到26.377 dB,LPIPS从0.074减少到0.043. 因此,改进既包括像素准确性,也包括感官相似性。 学习了全阶聚变和联合解码器训练,在不增加生成器潜在符号计数或通道维度的情况下恢复更细的图像细节.
如图3所示,HIRAE-24更忠实地保留了文字中风和当地颜色. RAEv2保留了整体图像内容,但在精细结构和局部色调变化中表现出扭曲. 这些比较补充了rFID的改进,表明受控的分级聚变可以在保持场景结构的同时恢复图像特定的细节.
改进范围还延伸到原始图像纹理强度的所有四个四分位。 更多纹理图像显示LPIPS减少较大,去除浅残留组(Appendix C.3 )产生较大效果,补充视觉实例.

blocks.en: Higher reconstruction fidelity coexists with competitive guided generation. As shown in Table 2 , HiRAE-24 achieves a guided gFID of 1.038 after 80 epochs of generator training, compared with 1.060 for RAEv2 at the same training duration. IS also increases from 255.300 to 257.823. The reconstruction gain therefore coexists with competitive guided generation in the same representation learned from the full encoder hierarchy. DecQ [ 22 ] appends eight detail-query tokens. It generates these alongside the original patch tokens, whereas HiRAE-24 integrates hierarchical information into the existing patch-token layout. Their comparable gFID shows that detail enrichment can support competitive generation within the original latent token count and channel dimension. REPA-E [ 12 ] obtains its tokenizer through end-to-end VAE–diffusion tuning; HiRAE learns fusion and decoding over a frozen encoder, then freezes the tokenizer for generator training. Figure 4 shows selected outputs spanning animals, objects, and scenes, combining coherent object structure with fine local detail. Without guidance, Table 3 shows that HiRAE-24 achieves a gFID of 2.129, improving on RAEv2 K=23’s 3.010 while remaining above RAEv2’s 1.650.

HiRAE-7 and HiRAE-24 achieve higher text–image alignment scores than RAEv2 both after pretraining and after supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Table 4 compares FLUX-VAE [ 1 ] , RAEv2 [ 20 ] , HiRAE-7, and HiRAE-24 as frozen image tokenizers after 100K generator pretraining steps and after SFT. At inference, all four evaluated configurations use classifier-free guidance (CFG) with scale 6 and internal guidance disabled. We report GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench scores; Appendix A.4 gives implementation details.
After pretraining, HiRAE-24 improves GenEval by 4.52 points and DPG-Bench by 1.51 points over RAEv2. This advantage persists after SFT, with gains of 2.84, 1.45, and 0.97 points on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench, respectively. HiRAE-7 also exceeds RAEv2 on every available benchmark, while HiRAE-24 improves further across both stages. These results extend the evidence for learned fusion from class-conditioned generation to text-conditioned generation and support the full-depth configuration without prior layer-subset selection. Figure 11 in Appendix F.4 compares the four methods on five selected GenEval prompts after SFT.

blocks.en: Applying DRoRAE-style layer experts and learned aggregation [ 29 ] within RAEv2 improves both reconstruction and guided generation (Table 6 ). On the same seven selected layers, HiRAE-7 reduces rFID from 0.299 to 0.217 and guided gFID from 1.060 to 1.038. HiRAE-24 uses all 24 layers to remove the prerequisite of selecting a suitable subset, while HiRAE-7 remains a compact extension when a subset is available. For full-depth fusion, we compare HiRAE-24 with DRoRAE-style fusion adapted to RAEv2, using 24 experts in both configurations. The adapted DRoRAE-style fusion achieves lower rFID (0.065 versus 0.209), whereas HiRAE-24 achieves lower guided gFID (1.038 versus 1.551) and FD r 6 \mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6} (1.856 versus 3.375). These results show that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient for choosing a fusion method for guided generation. HiRAE-24 improves reconstruction over RAEv2 while achieving competitive guided generation performance, supporting its use for both reconstruction and generation.

HIRAE-24使用所有24层来取消选择合适的子集的前提条件,而HIRAE-7在有子集时仍然是紧凑的扩展. 对于全深度核聚变,我们将HIRAE-24与适应RAEv2的DRORAE式核聚变进行比较,使用两种配置的24位专家. 改造后的DRORAE式聚变实现较低的rFID(0.065对0.209),而HIRAE-24则实现较低的导引GFID(1.038对1.551)和FD r 6\mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6}(1.856对3.375). 这些结果表明,仅靠重建忠心不足以选择一种聚变方法来进行导引生成。 HIRAE-24改进了RAEv2的重建,同时实现了有竞争力的引导生成性能,支持其用于重建和生成.

blocks.en: Table 5 compares three configurations trained for 16 tokenizer epochs, with generation evaluated on 50K guided samples from EMA generators at epochs 20 and 80. blocks.en:
Fusion expands spatial variation while retaining class organization. Figure 5 (a) visualizes RAEv2 and HiRAE-24 on the same 500 images using PHATE [ 16 ] , which provides a low-dimensional visualization of the representations. In the original feature space, the same-class fraction among ten nearest neighbors over 5,000 matched images is 74.454% for RAEv2 and 79.536% for HiRAE-24.
Within HiRAE-24, this fraction changes from 79.634% for the deep anchor to 79.536% after fusion, indicating largely preserved class neighborhoods. Across 100 fixed images, one per class, spatial effective rank increases from 130.360 for the deep anchor, LN ⁡ ( H 23 ) \operatorname{LN}(H_{23}) , to 154.893 for the fused representation, with an increase in every image (Figure 5 (b)). Meanwhile, mean spatial centered kernel alignment (CKA; 11 ) remains 0.985. Thus, spatial variation spreads over more feature directions while the patch-relationship structure remains similar.

Spatial enrichment coexists with lower decoding sensitivity. Figure 5 (c) measures LPIPS between clean and perturbed decodings under Gaussian, low-frequency, and high-frequency latent perturbations. We measure each tokenizer’s decoding response through its own inverse normalization and trained decoder. At a perturbation norm equal to 10% of the standardized latent norm, HiRAE-24 produces 21%–22% of RAEv2’s output LPIPS change across the three direction types.
The trained generator also predicts HiRAE-24 latents more accurately across intermediate noise levels. At seven matched coefficient log signal-to-noise ratio (log-SNR) levels, HiRAE-24 has lower clean-latent mean squared error than RAEv2 at the five interior levels and slightly higher error at both endpoints. Appendix E provides the full results and protocol. The diagnostics show lower latent prediction error at intermediate noise levels and lower decoding sensitivity to the perturbations.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: HiRAE learns high-fidelity visual tokenizers through joint fusion and decoder training, with depth-dependent residual bounds controlling each depth group’s contribution. HiRAE-24 learns the contributions of all 24 encoder layers without manual layer-subset selection or a separate fusion-only adaptation phase. ImageNet-256 results show higher reconstruction fidelity than RAEv2 with competitive guided generation within the original latent dimensions. Matched-image analyses connect the added detail to complementary information across depth groups and largely preserved class neighborhoods. HiRAE-7 extends the framework to compact fusion over an established subset.
blocks.zh: HIRAE通过联合聚变和解码器训练学习高纯度视觉标致器,由深度依赖的剩余界限控制每个深度组的贡献. HIRAE-24学习了所有24个编码层的贡献,没有手动的层子集选择或单独的聚变唯一适应阶段. ImageNet-256的结果表明,与RAEv2相比,重建忠心程度更高,在最初的潜在层面具有竞争性的引导生成。 匹配的图像分析将新增的细节与跨深度组的互补信息联系起来,并基本保留了阶级街区. HIRAE-7将框架扩展到一个既定子集的紧凑聚.

blocks.en: Stage 1 uses the ViT-XL decoder configuration. Pixel reconstruction is an L1 loss. The perceptual loss [ 26 ] has weight 1.0. The adversarial term has base weight 0.75, multiplied by the adaptive weight derived from decoder gradients, capped at 10000. Discriminator updates begin at epoch 6, and the decoder’s adversarial objective begins at epoch 8. The DINO-based discriminator uses a hinge loss; the generator objective is the negative mean discriminator logit. These objectives train the decoder and fusion jointly. The tokenizer optimizer is AdamW with betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) .
blocks.zh: 第一阶段采用VIT-XL解码器配置. 像素重建是一个L1损失. 知觉损失[26]有重量1.0. 对抗性术语具有0.75的基准重量乘以从解码梯度中得出的适应性重量,上限为10 000。 歧视者更新开始于第6期,解码员的对抗目标开始于第8期. 以DINO为基础的歧视者使用链条损失;生成者的目标是负平均值歧视者登录。 这些目标共同训练解码器和聚变. 标致器优化器为带β的亚当W(0.9,0.95).

Its latent patch size is 1. Class conditioning uses eight class tokens and four time tokens; label-dropout probability is 0.1. The configuration specifies x x prediction and logit-normal time sampling, with time-distribution shift dimensions 262144 and base 4096. Stage 2 uses the configured GMuon optimizer, momentum 0.95 and Nesterov acceleration. The tokenizer’s final EMA latent mean and variance are estimated before diffusion training.

blocks.en: RAEv2, HiRAE-7, and HiRAE-24 use DINOv3-L/16 and produce a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid of 1024-dimensional latent tokens. HiRAE-24 and HiRAE-7 use their epoch-16 EMA tokenizers. HiRAE-7 and RAEv2 use encoder layers { 11 , 13 , 15 , 17 , 19 , 21 , 23 } \{11,13,15,17,19,21,23\} with zero-based indexing. Our RAEv2 baseline uses the official DINOv3-L tokenizer, decoder, and latent statistics; we train its T2I generator under the same recipe as the HiRAE generators. FLUX-VAE uses the FLUX autoencoder paired with our trained DiT. Each configuration uses its own decoder and latent normalization statistics. Both T2I pretraining and SFT train only the generator, with the tokenizer, decoder, and text encoder frozen.
blocks.zh: RAEv2,HIRAE-7,和HIRAE-24使用DINov3-L/16,并产生16×16 16\时16格的1024维潜兆. HIRAE-24和HIRAE-7使用它们的划时代-16EMA配音器. HIRAE-7和RAEv2使用编码器层 { 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23 } \{ 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23 } 零基索引. 我们的RAEv2基线使用官方的DINov3-L标定器、解码器和潜在统计数据;我们用与HIRAE发电机相同的配方来培训其T2I发电机。 FLUX-VAE使用FLUX自动编码器与我们训练的DiT对齐. 每个配置都使用自己的解码器和潜在的正常化统计. T2I预训和SFT列车均仅限发电机,其中标致器,解码器,文本编码器被冻结.

blocks.en: The DiT with DDT head follows RAEv2 [ 20 ] , with backbone/head depths of 28/2, hidden widths of 1440/2048, and attention-head counts of 20/16. The MLP ratio is 4, and latent patch size is 1. The generator contains approximately 875M parameters, excluding the frozen modules. Qwen3-0.6B provides up to 256 caption tokens; the model also uses four time-conditioning tokens and condition dropout of 0.1. Training uses x x prediction, logit-normal time sampling with shift 8, and a time-denominator floor of 0.05. The transport objective converts the prediction to velocity and computes squared error. The internal-guidance base branch has depth 8 and loss coefficient 1.0. We disable REPA and additional tokenizer noise during generator training.
blocks.zh: 带有滴滴涕头的DiT跟随RAEv2 [20],骨干/头部深度28/2,隐藏宽度1440/2048,注意力头计数20/16. MLP比为4,潜在补丁尺寸为1. 发电机包含约875M参数,不包括冷冻模块. Qune3-0.6B提供最多256个字幕符号;该型号还使用4个时间调节符号和0.1个条件退出. 训练使用xx预测,以8号班机对数正常时间取样,定时计时器底座0.05. 运输目标将预测转换为速度并计算平方误差。 内部指导基础分支有深度8和损失系数1.0. 在发电机训练期间,我们禁用REPA和额外的信号器噪音。

blocks.en: Pretraining streams 5,141 tar shards through WebDataset: 419 from JourneyDB, 2,891 from BLIP3o Long-Caption, and 1,831 from BLIP3o Short-Caption. We shuffle the combined shard list before distributing it across ranks and workers, with additional shard and sample shuffle buffers. Images undergo RGB conversion, bicubic resizing of the shorter edge to 256, and a 256 × 256 256\times 256 center crop; the loader skips decoding failures. SFT uses 58,859 decoded image–text pairs from 11 BLIP3o-60k shards. We cache the same preprocessing as lossless PNG images in an Arrow dataset and shuffle the dataset with a distributed sampler each epoch. Each SFT epoch contains 57 optimizer updates, covering 58,368 sample presentations after dropping incomplete accumulation groups.
blocks.zh: Pretraining streams 5,141 tar shards通过WebDataset:419 from JourneyDB,2,891 from BLIP3o Long-Caption,1,831 from BLIP3o Short-Caption. 我们先把综合的硬名单 分到各军种和工人之间 再加一些硬的和样品的缓冲剂 图像经过RGB转换,比立方体将较短的边缘重缩到256,并且一个256×256\times 256中心作物;加载器跳过解码失败. SFT使用来自11个BLIP3o-60k硬盘的58,859个解码图像–文本对. 我们在Arrow数据集中缓存与没有丢失的 PNG 图像相同的预处理,并用每个时代的分布式采样器来洗涤数据集. 每个SFT纪元包含57个优化器更新,覆盖了58,368个样本演示,在放弃不完整的累积组后.

blocks.en: Table 11 summarizes the shared training settings. Two-dimensional parameters use GMuon with momentum 0.95, Nesterov updates, and RMS-norm learning-rate adjustment; other parameters use AdamW with betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} . Both parameter groups use zero weight decay and the same learning-rate schedule. Pretraining holds the learning rate at 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} for 50K updates, then follows a linear decay targeting 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} at 150K updates. We evaluate at 100K updates, where the nominal learning rate is 1.1 × 10 − 4 1.1\times 10^{-4} . SFT initializes model and EMA weights from the corresponding 100K checkpoint and resets the optimizer and scheduler. It warms up for 100 updates and then decays linearly to 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} over a total budget of 2,850 updates.

Pretraining将50K更新的学习率维持在2×10−4 2\times 10×4},然后在150K更新时跟踪针对2×10−5 2\times 10×5}的线性衰变. 校对:Soup SFT从相应的100K检查站初始化模型和EMA重量,并重置优化器和调度器. 它热了100个更新,然后线性衰减到2×10−5 2\times 10×5}超过总预算2850个更新.

blocks.en: All reported T2I evaluations use EMA weights, BF16, 50 Euler steps, time shift 8, and CFG=6 over the full sampling interval. We disable internal guidance at inference while retaining its base-branch loss during training. We generate one 256 × 256 256\times 256 image per prompt: 553 images for GenEval, 1,065 for DPG-Bench, and 1,600 for GenAI-Bench-1600. All reported scores multiply the benchmark mean by 100.

blocks.en: For GenEval, we use the evaluation implementation released with RAEv2 [ 20 ] . DPG-Bench uses dpg-evaluator==0.1.0 with mPLUG VQA and question-dependency corrections. We first average question scores within each image and then average across images. GenAI-Bench uses CLIP-FlanT5-XL VQAScore averaged over paired images and prompts; this score is a continuous alignment measure. The scorer uses revision 3b4a6b1b618f4e286f5353b5b5147a3ae7d9ec55 .
blocks.zh: 对于GenEval,我们使用RAEv2发布的评价执行[20]. DPG-Bench使用dpg-evaluator ===0.1.0 带有mPLUG VQA和问题依赖性校正. 我们先是每个图像中的平均问分,然后是图像之间的平均分。 GenAI-Bench使用CLIP-FlanT5-XL VQAScore在对映的图像和提示上平均值;这个分数是一个连续的对齐度量. 计分器使用版本3b4a6b1b618f4e286f53b5b5b5147a3ae7d9ec55 .

我们将图像ID和预处理固定在标语器上,并将重建的RGB值夹到[0, 1] [0, 1] . PSNR从这个范围内的 RGB 平均平方误差中计算每个图像; LPIPS 使用 AlexNet 网络在映射到 [− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 的图像上. 这些子集测量补充了单独的50K rFID基准.

blocks.en: C.2 Paired improvements and spatial-detail errors
blocks.zh: C.2 改进和空间细节错误

blocks.en: Table 15 : Paired reconstruction improvements. HiRAE-24 minus each reference on the same 5,000 images. Intervals are 95% within-class paired image-bootstrap intervals; negative LPIPS differences indicate improvement.

blocks.en: We also compare spatial derivatives of the input and reconstruction. We convert images to grayscale with RGB weights ( 0.299 , 0.587 , 0.114 ) (0.299,0.587,0.114) . Sobel error averages the squared differences in horizontal and vertical responses, using the standard 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernels divided by 8. Laplacian error uses the four-neighbor kernel with center weight 4 and neighbor weights − 1 -1 . Both filters use valid convolution. Table 16 shows lower Sobel and Laplacian errors for HiRAE-24, consistent with the improved local detail in the selected reconstructions.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了投入和重建的空间衍生物。 我们用RGB重量(0.299,0.587,0.114)将图像转换成灰度(0.299,0.587,0.114). Sobel错误平均水平和垂直响应中的平方差异,使用标准3×3 3\times 3内核除以8. Laplacian 错误使用四邻内核,中重为4,邻重为−1-1. 两种过滤器都使用有效的演化. 表16显示HIRAE-24较低的Sobel和Laplacian误差,这与选定的重建中当地细节的改进是一致的。

blocks.en: Table 16 : Reconstruction of spatial detail. Mean derivative errors on the same matched 5K subset as Table 1 , multiplied by 10 3 10^{3} . Lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表16:空间细节重建. 同表1对应的5K子集的平均值派生错误乘以10 3 10^{3}. 低点更好

blocks.en: C.3 Reconstruction gains across texture strata
blocks.zh: C.3 不同纹理层的重建收益

blocks.en: To examine which images benefit, we rank the same 5,000 inputs by their mean grayscale Sobel-gradient magnitude and split them into four quartiles of 1,250 images. Strata depend only on the original images, not on reconstruction quality or method identity. We measure both the paired LPIPS reduction from RAEv2 to HiRAE-24 and the increase caused by removing HiRAE-24’s shallow residual group after its norm cap, keeping the remaining model fixed.
blocks.zh: 为了检查哪些图像受益,我们用其平均灰度的Sobel梯度量来排列同样的5000个输入,然后把它们分成4个四角形的1,250个图像。 斯特拉塔只依赖于原始图像,而不是重建质量或方法身份. 我们既测量了配对的LPIPS从RAEv2到HIRAE-24的减少量,又测量了HIRAE-24在规范封顶后移除浅残留组而导致的增量,保持了剩余型号的固定.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Texture-stratified reconstruction. Quartiles increase in original-image Sobel strength. Left: LPIPS reduction from RAEv2 to HiRAE-24. Right: LPIPS increase after removing HiRAE-24’s shallow group. Each quartile contains 1,250 images; error bars show 95% paired bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图6:纹理级重建。 夸尔人增加原画索贝尔强度. 左:从RAEv2到HIRAE-24的LPIPS还原. 右:删除HIRAE-24浅层组后LPIPS增加. 每个四角星包含1,250个图像;错误条显示95%的对靴间隔.

blocks.en: HiRAE-24 improves reconstruction in every quartile. From Q1 to Q4, absolute LPIPS gains rise from 0.022 to 0.039, while relative reductions decrease from 47.419% to 37.312%. We compute relative reduction as the mean paired LPIPS reduction divided by the mean baseline LPIPS within each quartile. Over the same quartiles, removing the shallow group increases LPIPS by 0.004 to 0.007 (Figure 6 ). These observations associate stronger original-image texture with a larger absolute reconstruction gain and a larger shallow-group contribution in the trained model.
blocks.zh: HIRAE-24改进了每夸尔的重建. 从Q1到Q4,LPIPS的绝对收益率从0.022上升到0.039,而相对的减少率从47.419%下降到37.312%. 我们计算相对的减少量,作为平均对齐的液化石油气排放减少量,除以每夸里的平均基线液化石油气排放减少量。 在相同的四分位数上,去除浅层组会使LPIPS增加0.004到0.007(图6). 这些观测结果将更强的原始图像纹理与更大的绝对重建收益和在训练有素模型中更大的浅层群体贡献联系起来.

blocks.en: All intervals use 1,000 image-resampling replicates within the fixed classes, with the same resampled IDs across paired conditions. Quartile assignments remain fixed and means are recomputed within each stratum. These intervals measure image-level sampling variability for the frozen checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 所有间隔使用1000个图像复制在固定类内复制,相同的重印ID跨越对称条件. Quartile的转让仍然是固定的,在每一层内部重新计算各种手段。 这些间隔测量了被冻结检查站图像一级的取样变化。

blocks.en: D.1 HiRAE-7: selected-layer extension
blocks.zh: D.1 HIRAE-7: 选定级别的扩展

blocks.en: HiRAE-7 applies DRoRAE-style layer experts and learned aggregation within the RAEv2 framework, using the established zero-based layer subset { 11 , 13 , 15 , 17 , 19 , 21 , 23 } \{11,13,15,17,19,21,23\} . It retains layer-specific experts, spatial routing, a deepest-layer anchor, and joint fusion–decoder training. Its router consumes concatenated normalized layer features and supplies spatially varying weights for aggregating the transformed expert outputs. Its training setup includes spatial smoothing and no router dropout. HiRAE-24 uses deepest-feature conditioning, three residual norm caps, and group dropout. The extension applies learned fusion to the selected-layer configuration.
blocks.zh: HIRAE-7在RAEv2框架内应用DRORAE风格的层层专家和学习汇总,使用既定的零基层子集{11,13,15,17,19,21,23}}##11,13,15,17,19,21,23}###11,19,21,23###. 它保留了分层专家、空间路径、最深层锚地和联合聚变-解码器培训。 它的路由器消耗了整齐的常态层特征,并提供了不同空间的权重,以汇总变化的专家产出。 其培训设置包括空间平滑和不中断路由器。 HIRAE-24采用最深的地貌调节,三个残留的规范上限,以及群体辍学. 扩展将学到的聚变应用于选定的层配置.

blocks.zh: 表17: HIRAE部分层次扩展. 专家参数不包括编码器,路由器,解码器,和生成器. rFID使用50K重建评价;PSNR/LPIPS使用匹配的5K子集. 世代使用来自时代-80发电机的50K样本.

blocks.en: D.2 DRoRAE-style full-depth fusion

blocks.en: The DRoRAE-style fusion comparator in Table 6 adapts DRoRAE’s layer experts, routing, and global interpolation [ 29 ] to the RAEv2 framework. It uses all blocks 0 , … , 23 0,\ldots,23 of DINOv3-L, 24 layer experts with hidden width 4 ​ C 4C , and the same 256 × 1024 256\times 1024 latent interface as HiRAE-24. Its router consumes concatenated normalized layer features and produces signed, ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized weights. Writing its normalized expert combination as F F , the output is Z = LN ⁡ [ ( 1 − β ) ​ H 23 + β ​ F ] Z=\operatorname{LN}[(1-\beta)H_{23}+\beta F] , with β = 0.2 \beta=0.2 . It jointly trains fusion and decoder with a routing smoothness weight of 0.1. HiRAE-24 instead uses deepest-feature routing and groupwise residual caps and dropout (Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 表6中DRORAE式的聚变参照物使DRORAE的层专家,路由,以及全球插值[29]适应RAEv2框架. 它使用所有区块 0,..., 23 0,\ldots, 23 of DINov3-L, 24层专家, 隐藏宽度 4 C 4C , 与 HIRAE-24 相同的256× 1024 256\time 1024 潜在接口. 它的路由器消耗了凝固的常态层特征,并产生已签名的,l 2\ell\2} - 常态化的权重. 将它的常态化的专家组合写成FF,输出为Z=LN Q[(1−β)H 23+βF]Z=\operatorname{LN}[(1-\β)H_{23}+\beta F],其中β=0.2\β=0.2. 它联合训练聚变和解码器,线路平滑重量为0.1. 相反,HIRAE-24采用了最深层的径路和分组式残余盖和退学(附录A.1)。

blocks.en: Both tokenizer configurations use 16 epochs, global batch size 128, decoder-input noise τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 , and the ViT-XL decoder. The comparator’s generator training uses global batch size 1024, GMuon, 25 warmup epochs, and a learning-rate decay endpoint at epoch 50, with the same DiT-with-DDT-head architecture. The generation results in Table 6 use each configuration’s final epoch-16 tokenizer and epoch-80 EMA generator; Table 18 additionally reports epoch-20 EMA results. Each evaluation uses 50K class-conditioned ImageNet-256 images. Their sampling configurations specify 100 Euler steps, CFG=1, and IG=1.78 on [ 0.1 , 1 ] [0.1,1] . We use a separate generated sample set for each configuration.
blocks.zh: 两种标致器配置均采用16个纪元,全球批量尺寸128,解码器-输入噪声τ=0.8\tau=0.8,以及ViT-XL解码器. 比较器的生成器训练采用全球批量尺寸1024,GMuon,25个热点,以及一个学习率衰减的终点在Epoch 50,与DDT头架构相同. 表6中的生成结果使用每个配置的最终划时代-16的标定器和划时代-80的EMA生成器;表18还报告了划时代-20的EMA结果. 每次评价都使用50K级有条件的ImageNet-256图像. 它们的采样配置指定了100欧勒步骤,CFG=1,IG=1.78在[0.1,1] [0.1,1]上. 我们为每个配置使用一个单独的生成样本集.

blocks.en: This comparison evaluates complete fusion configurations with the same backbone, source layers, expert count and width, and generator architecture. HiRAE-24 achieves better guided generation with depth-dependent residual budgets during joint fusion–decoder learning. Both configurations jointly train fusion and decoding; the comparator adapts DRoRAE’s fusion architecture to this setting. Its final epoch-16 tokenizer achieves reconstruction rFID 0.065498 (0.065 in Table 6 ) and also supplies the latents for generation.
blocks.zh: 这种比较评价了与同一主干,源层,专家计数和宽度,以及生成器架构的完整聚变配置. HIRAE-24在联合核聚变-解码器学习过程中,通过依靠深度的剩余预算,实现了更好的引导生成. 两种配置都联合训练聚变和解码;比较者将DRORAE的聚变架构适应这个设置. 其最终的划时代的16号标注器实现了0.065498(表6中的0.065)的重建,也为一代人提供了潜质。

blocks.en: Table 18 compares both fusion configurations after 20 and 80 generator epochs. At 20 epochs, the adapted DRoRAE-style fusion reaches gFID 2.244, close to HiRAE-24’s 2.242, while HiRAE-24 has a 51.9% lower FD r 6 \mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6} . Extending training to 80 epochs improves this comparator to gFID 1.551 and FD r 6 \mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6} 3.375. Over the same interval, HiRAE-24 reduces gFID by 53.7%, compared with 30.9% for the adapted DRoRAE-style fusion, and reaches gFID 1.038 with FD r 6 \mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6} 1.856. The larger gFID improvement and lower final values of both generation metrics motivate our choice of HiRAE-24 for the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 表18比较了20和80发电机时代之后的两种聚变配置. 在20世纪,经过改造的DRORAE式聚变达到gFID 2.244,接近HIRAE-24的2.242,而HIRAE-24的FD r 6\mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6}则有51.9%的低调. 将训练范围扩大到80个世纪,使这个参照国改进为gFID 1.551和FD r 6\mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6}3.375。 在同一间隔期间,HIRAE-24将GFID减少了53.7%,而经过改造的DRORAE型核聚变则减少了30.9%,并用FD r 6\mathrm{FD}_{r}^{6}达到GFID 1.038. 两代度量的GFID改进和较低的最终值促使我们选择HIRAE-24进行主要实验。

blocks.zh: 表18:培训预算的全面深入构成。 两种配置都使用全部24层和24位专家. 减量使用经过改造的DRORAE式聚变作为参考.

blocks.zh: 表5报告了共同的20世纪预算的三个配置以及两个正规化配置的现有80世纪成果。 第一阶段解码器和正常化统计是每个受过训练的标注器所特有的。

Stage 1 uses a fixed, class-balanced ImageNet training subset of 128,000 images, with 128 images per class and the same sample order across configurations. The optimizer, EMA, reconstruction objectives, decoder noise, and discriminator schedule follow Appendix A.2 , with epoch-based schedules measured on this subset. Each configuration then freezes its final EMA tokenizer and computes its own latent normalization statistics on the same 128,000 images.

Each run uses eight H800 GPUs, microbatch size 64 per GPU, two accumulation steps, and global batch size 1024. GMuon uses a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} from the first update, momentum 0.95, Nesterov acceleration, and zero weight decay; gradient clipping is 1.0 and EMA decay is 0.9995. All configurations share the class sequence, sampling seed 42, eight GPUs, and batch size 16 per GPU. Unguided sampling uses CFG=IG=1; guided sampling uses CFG=1 and IG=1.78 on [ 0.1 , 1.0 ] [0.1,1.0] . We compute gFID and IS with the same project Inception implementation and ImageNet reference statistics from guided_diffusion_stats.npz .

blocks.en: D.5 Layer-group and frequency interventions
blocks.zh: D.5 层组和频率干预
